properties.statement: Hashed changed source files by hand (sha256sum per file, then a script mapping paths to artifact ids from the export) to feed set_artifact_checksums — roughly six times across the day, once per PR, and once WRONGLY: the root AGENTS.md's hash was stamped onto the kit copy's artifact because the location was read off the artifact's name rather than its `location` property. The qs project reported the identical shape on 2026-09-04 ('hashes by hand, about forty times'). reflow2 does no file I/O by design; the hand-rolled part is the path-to-artifact mapping plus the hashing plus the accept call, and the mistake it produced is exactly the kind a tool that reads the artifact's own location would not make.
